sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A solitary palm endemic to Lord Howe Island, where it grows on coral or basalt soils from sea level to about 300 m. It can reach 20 m.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The pinnate leaves are about 3–5 m long. The inflorescences are branched and pendulous; the drupes ripen red and are about 3–5 cm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use is documented for this ornamental species.
